description: This file provides utility functions for normalizing and resolving Slack tokens within the openclaw plugin SDK. It defines functions to process raw inputs and retrieve Slack tokens associated with different roles (channel token, bot token, app token, user token) through a helper function that normalizes secret input strings.

methods.name: export function normalizeSlackToken(raw?: unknown): string | undefined { normalizeSlackToken
methods.description: Normalizes a raw Slack token input, primarily used for channel tokens, using the secret input normalization utility.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackBotToken( resolveSlackBotToken
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the Slack bot token, defaulting to a specific path in the secret store.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackAppToken( resolveSlackAppToken
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the Slack app token from the secret store.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackUserToken( resolveSlackUserToken
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the Slack user token from the secret store.
